title: When service needs its center back under pressure
issueStatement: The work may still be happening, but the heart has started bargaining with it. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it. Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement.
actionPrompt: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
